{
  "project_id": "P-MNG-ThirdEnergySector",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Electricity tariffs set below the cost of service cause persistent financial deficits across sector utilities, threatening the ongoing operational and financial viability of energy infrastructure.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize analytical support and technical assistance under the project to assist the government in formulating and implementing a comprehensive tariff reform strategy and utility financial sustainability plan.",
      "evidence": "The current electricity price is below the cost of service causing financial difficulties for sector utilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Administrative and technical capacity constraints within the implementing entity could lead to implementation delays and contract management inefficiencies.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated Project Management Office (PMO) under the Ministry of Energy, engage an Owner's Engineer to support procurement and supervision, and provide targeted capacity-building programs.",
      "evidence": "Previous infrastructure projects in Mongolia have experienced implementation delays due to the administrative and technical capacity constraints of the implementing agencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "An aging, rigid coal-fired Combined Heat and Power (CHP) generation fleet limits system flexibility and restricts the dispatch and grid integration of Variable Renewable Energy (VRE).",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Reinforce the 220kV transmission backbone to expand transfer capacity and conduct technical assistance studies on grid planning and VRE integration strategies.",
      "evidence": "Most of the CHP units are aging... inefficient and highly polluting. The CHP plants make the power system inflexible, making it indispatchable..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Overhead high-voltage transmission line construction and operation pose bird collision and habitat disruption risks along sensitive ecological zones and wetlands.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Realign the transmission line corridor away from sensitive wetlands, install flight diverters and bird-friendly tower solutions, and execute a comprehensive Bird Management Plan.",
      "evidence": "Transmission lines in Mongolia often involve bird collision and other biodiversity issues"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Extreme winter conditions, severe cold, high wind loads, and climate hazards could cause structural damage to transmission infrastructure and disrupt project construction.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate-resilient design and engineering standards for transmission towers and insulators to withstand extreme wind loading, freezing temperatures, and natural hazards.",
      "evidence": "Mongolia is prone to risks from climate hazards such as flooding, wildfires, and landslides, with exposure to drought and extreme cold..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "High reliance on imported construction materials (75-80%) exposes the project to supply chain disruptions, border delays, and material cost volatility.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early supply market intelligence, perform advance procurement planning, and incorporate rated criteria evaluating material sourcing and delivery strategies.",
      "evidence": "The construction sector in Mongolia has been heavily reliant on imports, with statistics showing that 75-80% of construction materials are sourced from outside..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "The short construction season in Mongolia risks civil works overruns into winter, causing project completion delays of up to an entire year.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Initiate advance procurement to ensure contracts are awarded prior to the start of the construction season, and evaluate contractors on their technical plans for seasonal optimization.",
      "evidence": "the seasonal nature of civil works in Mongolia adds more risks... If it cannot be completed before winter, the Project will have more delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Substandard or unqualified local construction materials could compromise structural integrity and safety standards of transmission infrastructure.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate non-price rated evaluation criteria assessing material quality control strategies, and enforce mandatory quality testing supervised by the Owner's Engineer.",
      "evidence": "40% of construction materials were found unqualified in the local market."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Civil works along the right-of-way may cause temporary disruption to local herders' pasture access, water wells, and community safety.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP), Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF), and operate a accessible two-stage project Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM).",
      "evidence": "temporary social risks and impacts... temporary restriction of access to resources by local herders (for example, pasture, wells, etc.)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Frequent turnover of decision-making officials and high-level political interference in procurement decisions may cause significant procedural delays.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear procurement workflows and delegation of authority in the Project Operational Manual, maintain oversight through the Project Steering Committee, and enforce World Bank review procedures.",
      "evidence": "Frequent change of the decision-making officials for the Project. Interference of the high-level officials in procurement decision making which leads to delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Evaluation Committee members' lack of familiarity with World Bank procurement regulations and English bidding documentation could prolong contract evaluations.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide structured training on World Bank procurement regulations, evaluation procedures, and standard bidding documents for PMO staff and Evaluation Committee members prior to procurement launching.",
      "evidence": "Evaluation Committee members normally do not have knowledge and experience in procurement for Bank-financed projects..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Complex Treasury Single Account flow-of-funds procedures involving local currency investment sub-accounts could create disbursement bottlenecks and vendor payment delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a segregated USD Designated Account with commercial zero-balance pass-through mechanisms and defined payment approval workflows in the Financial Management Manual.",
      "evidence": "Delays and bottlenecks in the project funds flow arrangements that got complicated with the addition of an investment project account within the Treasury..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Gender-based biases and structural obstacles in the power sector limit female representation and career progression in engineering and management roles.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct a comprehensive gender gap assessment, introduce gender-responsive HR practices, provide targeted professional development, and monitor workforce gender target metrics.",
      "evidence": "gender-based biases may be an obstacle to women’s employment and especially to career progression at NPTG."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Lack of grid redundancy in single-circuit transmission corridors leads to severe prolonged power supply outages during line faults.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct a second 220kV double-circuit transmission line between Baganuur and Choir substations to establish full double-circuit redundancy.",
      "evidence": "The region served by the existing Baganuur-Choir single circuit line experienced a supply outage of 33 hours in 2021 caused by a fault on the line."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delays in establishing the Project Management Office and finalizing operational documentation could postpone project effectiveness and early implementation.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set the adoption of the Project Operational Manual and formal establishment of the PMO as legal conditions of loan effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "PMO is not yet in place and no financial management staff has been appointed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Occupational health and safety hazards during construction and maintenance including high-voltage exposure, work at height, and electromagnetic fields.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce Labor Management Procedures (LMP), align safety protocols with World Bank Environmental, Health, and Safety Guidelines, and require full-time contractor OHS specialists.",
      "evidence": "occupational health and safety (OHS) risks associated with live power lines, working at height, electric and magnetic fields (EMF)."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Electricity tariffs set below the cost of service cause persistent financial deficits across sector utilities, threatening the ongoing operational and financial viability of energy infrastructure.
risks.mitigation: Utilize analytical support and technical assistance under the project to assist the government in formulating and implementing a comprehensive tariff reform strategy and utility financial sustainability plan.
risks.evidence: The current electricity price is below the cost of service causing financial difficulties for sector utilities.

risks.description: Administrative and technical capacity constraints within the implementing entity could lead to implementation delays and contract management inefficiencies.

risks.evidence: Most of the CHP units are aging... inefficient and highly polluting. The CHP plants make the power system inflexible, making it indispatchable...
